review.notes: Resolves the single residue of REV-PKG-EllipticRegulators~adv (Bloch, CRM Monograph 11, unavailable): no statement now rests on the book. Bloch locators were removed except Theorem 10.2.1, Lemma 10.2.2 (p. 77) and (8.1.4) (p. 62), which Brunault's thesis cites (pp. 23-24). Bloch-credited statements are sourced to free texts (Brunault's thesis; Goncharov-Levin arXiv:alg-geom/9508008v4 §§1.2, 3.1, 3.3; Zagier 1990; Dokchitser-de Jeu-Zagier) or proved in the README. All assertions about the book's text or misprints were removed (listed in the handoff for collation with an authorized copy). §3.16 is proved by the Stokes route; §§3.11-3.15 are rewritten as the roadmap's own second proof, and §3.12(iv) is corrected (total log-sum 0, not log|1-K|). finiteFourier10 is renamed torsionFourier, and the Lean theorem ellipticR_diamond_steinberg is added. Independent computations: the CM theorem (32a2, 36a1, 49a1 at C=7 and 14; Gamma=2,3,7,28; units-only index gives 2L) to 2e-15; the closed forms of §§4.10-4.16 and Theorem 10.2.1 for random odd complex f to 2e-12; the Steinberg relation to 2e-14; §4.3 lift values; §3.7. The reviewer's earlier in-place fixes are kept. lean-check: exit 0, 27 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry', no errors. intake check-files: 0 problems.
